modules.title: 一批任务怎样经过队列、并发上限和 429 重试
请求怎样排队并按限制重试

items.title: 先进入队列
items.text: 产品把很多任务排队，只放一部分同时执行；这叫控制并发数。

items.title: 达到限制会 429
items.text: 429 是服务常用的“请求太多”状态，表示现在不应继续立即重试。

items.title: 按服务提示等待
items.text: 响应有 Retry-After 时按提示延后；没有时按服务文档逐步增加等待时间，并继续控制队列。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 收到 429 后立刻无限重试只会持续撞上限制，还可能让队列和故障更严重。

lessonPractice.title: 短时间内连续点击“重新生成”触发了限流。界面下一步该怎么做？

options.label: 停止立即重试，说明等待时间或可重试时机，并防止重复提交
options.feedback: 对。限流是暂时拒绝；明确等待和禁用重复动作能避免继续加重请求。

options.label: 在后台每 100 毫秒自动重试，直到成功
options.feedback: 高频重试会继续触发限制，也可能影响其他请求。

options.label: 不显示错误提示，让用户多点几次试试
options.feedback: 用户需要知道当前动作没有完成以及何时可以重试。

en.title: Rapid clicks on Regenerate hit a rate limit. What should the UI do next?

options.label: Stop immediate retries, explain when to retry, and prevent duplicate submission
options.feedback: Correct. A limit is temporary refusal; clear waiting guidance and duplicate prevention avoid making it worse.

options.label: Retry automatically every 100ms until it succeeds
options.feedback: Fast retries keep triggering the limit and can affect other requests.

options.label: Hide the error and let people click more
options.feedback: People need to know the action did not complete and when it can be retried.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 重新生成功能遇到限流时，请读取可用的等待信息，禁用重复点击并显示下一次可尝试的时间；到时间后恢复操作。模拟一次 429，确认只发出一次请求、用户看到等待说明，并能在等待结束后重试。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: When Regenerate is rate-limited, read any available wait information, disable duplicate clicks, and show when the next attempt is allowed; re-enable it then. Simulate one 429 and confirm only one request is sent, the wait is visible, and retry works after it ends.

learning.assumes: You have seen a queue, a retry-later message, or a request failure.
learning.outcome: You can respond to a 429 by queuing work, lowering concurrency, and waiting as instructed.

modules.title: How work reaches a queue, a concurrency limit, and a 429
How requests wait and retry within limits

items.title: Enter a queue
items.text: The product queues work and runs only some tasks at once; that controls concurrency.

items.title: A limit returns 429
items.text: 429 commonly means there are too many requests and an immediate retry is not appropriate.

items.title: Wait as instructed
items.text: Follow `Retry-After` when supplied, or use documented backoff while keeping the queue controlled.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Unlimited immediate retries after 429 keep hitting the limit and can make queues and failures worse.
